question: Evaluate: 22 - [22 - {22 - (22 - 22 × 4)}]
solution:
**Given:**

22 - [22 - {22 - (22 - 22 × 4)}]

**Formula used:**

Follow the BODMAS rule (Brackets, Orders, Division/Multiplication, Addition/Subtraction)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 22 - [22 - {22 - (22 - 22 × 4)}]

⇒ 22 - [22 - {22 - (22 - 88)}]

⇒ 22 - [22 - {22 - (-66)}]

⇒ 22 - [22 - {22 + 66}]

⇒ 22 - [22 - 88]

⇒ 22 - (-66)

⇒ 22 + 66

⇒ 88

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
